# StackEleven

> Web design studio building websites, booking, ads, and CRM for pickleball and padel clubs — so their courts stay full.

StackEleven designs and builds the complete digital growth engine for racket-sports clubs. The studio pairs website design with booking integration, paid campaigns, and CRM, and knows the racket-sports market (memberships, clinics, tournaments, camps).

## Services
- Custom high-performance club websites
- Booking platform integration
- Paid ad campaigns (membership drives, tournament promos)
- CRM and funnel attribution

## Engagement models
- US clubs: Free Agency Model — $0 upfront, the studio earns as bookings grow.
- Europe: Entry Model — custom build starting at ~$1,000.

## Portfolio (live club sites built by StackEleven)
- Pickleball Junction — https://www.pickleball-junction.com/
- Gotham Pickleball — https://gotham-pickleball.com
